summary: Completed SEO pre-rendering testing for worldautofrance.com. The nginx pre-rendering system IS WORKING CORRECTLY on production. All 29 backend tests passed. The SEO endpoint returns proper HTML with meta tags, Schema.org, and substantial content when accessed with Googlebot User-Agent.

minor.issue: HEAD requests return 405 Method Not Allowed. While Google primarily uses GET, some crawlers may use HEAD for status checks. This is unlikely to cause Soft 404 but could be improved.

passed_tests: SEO endpoint /seo/annonce/{id} returns 200 for valid listings
SEO endpoint returns proper HTML content-type
SEO page contains dynamic title with listing name and price
SEO page contains all Open Graph tags (og:type, og:url, og:title, og:description, og:image)
SEO page contains canonical URL pointing to production domain
SEO page contains valid Schema.org JSON-LD Product markup
SEO endpoint returns 404 for non-existent listings
SEO page has robots meta tag allowing indexing
nginx.conf detects all Google crawler User-Agents
nginx.conf has /annonce/ location with error_page 418 trick
SEO page has no soft 404 indicators
SEO page has substantial content (>200 chars)
SEO pages have unique content per listing
All 11 Google User-Agents are detected by nginx pattern
action_items: IMPORTANT: The SEO pre-rendering IS WORKING on production (worldautofrance.com). Tested with curl and Googlebot User-Agent - returns proper SEO HTML.
The Soft 404 errors in Google Search Console are likely STALE data from before the pre-rendering was implemented. Google needs to re-crawl these pages.
RECOMMENDED: Use Google Search Console's 'Request Indexing' feature on the affected URLs to trigger a re-crawl
RECOMMENDED: Submit the sitemap again in Google Search Console to prompt re-indexing
OPTIONAL: Add HEAD method support to /seo/annonce/{id} endpoint for better crawler compatibility
critical_code_review_comments: nginx.conf SEO pre-rendering configuration is correct and working
Backend /seo/annonce/{id} endpoint generates proper SEO HTML with all required meta tags
Schema.org JSON-LD is valid and properly structured
The error_page 418 trick for crawler detection is a valid nginx pattern
All major Google crawler User-Agents are covered in the detection pattern
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO pre-rendering is working correctly on production. The Soft 404 errors in Google Search Console are likely stale data. The main agent should advise the user to: 1) Request re-indexing of affected URLs in GSC, 2) Resubmit sitemap, 3) Wait for Google to re-crawl. The preview environment (bugfix-marketplace.preview.emergentagent.com) does NOT have nginx pre-rendering configured - this is expected as it uses React dev server.
